# PartitionEmbeddingStatus

A partition's embedding settings as they apply, with every default filled in, and the state of its index: which model it is indexed with, and whether search is available.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `partitionId` | `uuid` | The partition. |
| `provider` | [`EmbeddingProvider`](embedding-provider.md) | The provider in use. |
| `model` | `string` | The model id in use. |
| `dimensions` | `integer` | The vector width in use. |
| `chunkSizeTokens` | `integer` | The chunk size in use, in tokens. |
| `chunkOverlapTokens` | `integer` | The chunk overlap in use, in tokens. |
| `vectorSpaceKey` | `string` | Identifies the provider, model and width together (`provider/model@width`). Only vectors with the same key can be compared. |
| `isDefaultProfile` | `boolean` | True when the partition has no profile of its own and uses Maitento's default. |
| `isModelWithdrawn` | `boolean` | True when the partition is indexed with a model Maitento no longer offers. The partition still works, searches and re-indexes, but you should move it to a supported model. |
| `isCustomModel` | `boolean` | True when the partition embeds with your own model rather than one Maitento lists (a custom profile). |
| `index` | [`PartitionEmbeddingIndexState`](partition-embedding-index-state.md) | The index state. `Ready`, with no counts, for a partition that has never been re-indexed. |
| `isSearchAvailable` | `boolean` | Whether search on the partition is currently served. Set by Maitento. |
